name: Year Grid
description: A year of daily counts as a grid of small squares on a five-step water ramp, with stat tiles and a control that regroups the days by week, month or year.

props.name: year
props.description: The calendar year the grid shows.

props.name: data
props.description: One count per day from 1 January. A shorter array leaves the remaining days empty and ends the current streak at its last day.

props.name: grouping
props.description: Controlled grouping: columns of weeks, a calendar page per month, or a row per month with days 1 to 31 across.

props.name: defaultGrouping
props.description: Grouping to start with when uncontrolled.

props.name: onGroupingChange
props.description: Called when the segmented control changes the grouping.

props.name: controls
props.description: Show the Weekly, Monthly, Yearly segmented control in the header. A passed action replaces it.

props.name: name
props.description: What is counted, shown in the tooltip. Defaults to the card label.

props.name: colors
props.description: The ramp from the lowest step to the highest. Defaults to five evenly spaced water steps, from a quiet empty cell to brand-strong.

props.name: thresholds
props.description: Lowest count for each step after the first coloured one, ascending. Defaults to quantiles of the days with any activity.

props.name: format
props.description: Writes counts in the tooltip and tiles. Defaults to grouped whole numbers.

props.name: stats
props.description: Show the tiles for total, peak day, longest streak and current streak.

props.name: legend
props.description: Show the date range and the Less to More ramp under the grid.

props.name: summary
props.description: What the chart shows, for screen readers. Generated from the data when left out.

props.name: label
props.description: Small muted label at the top of the card.

props.name: delta
props.description: Change as a signed fraction, shown as a chip beside the value.

props.name: action
props.description: Replaces the segmented control on the right of the header.

props.name: footer
props.description: Replaces the date range and legend under the grid.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the card, e.g. a width. Also accepts caption, note, invertDelta and every other prop of a div.
